decisions.reason: As a new safety-shoe line in the firm’s core category, it likely stays because a large established producer with slack and flexible production usually gives such launches time unless early results clearly fall below aspiration levels.

The comfort insole fits the existing footwear system and is inexpensive to carry, but as a less prominently positioned add-on it faces a somewhat higher drop risk if sales fall short of management’s aspirations.

The supportive insole is adjacent to the core business and benefits from organisational slack, yet its lower visibility and overlap with other insole offers make it more vulnerable if performance is merely mediocre.

An ergonomic safety-shoe series with its own page signals strategic importance and satisfactory early attention, so under behavioral theory management would be unlikely to abandon it quickly in a resource-rich firm.

Firefighter and rescue boots are a credible extension of protective footwear capabilities, and the firm’s specialist manufacturing and service network make continued support likely unless niche demand badly disappoints.

Because the moulded insole was highlighted on the home page and described as a flagship direction, management is likely to protect it and continue learning from it unless results are clearly far below aspiration.
